essential_price_rules: Must be composed of exactly five (5) segments. The 2nd segment cannot retrace 100% of the 1st segment. The 4th segment cannot retrace 100% of the 3rd segment. The 3rd segment can never be the shortest of the three advancing segments (waves 1, 3, and 5).
extension_rule: One of the advancing waves (1, 3, or 5) must be noticeably longer in price than all others, typically at least 161.8% of the next longest wave.
trading_action: Wait for the 5-segment pattern to complete and confirm the extension rule before anticipating a trend reversal or correction.

essential_price_rules: Wave 1 is the longest wave, being at least 161.8% of Wave 3. Wave 3 must be longer than Wave 5.
time_rules: Wave 2 usually consumes more time than Wave 4.
trading_action: If Wave 1 extends, expect a deep correction for Wave 2. Do not go long immediately after Wave 1 completes.

essential_price_rules: Wave 3 is the longest wave, being at least 161.8% of Wave 1. Wave 1 and Wave 5 tend to be equal in price and time.
time_rules: Wave 4 often becomes complex and consumes more time than Wave 2.
trading_action: If Wave 3 extends, prepare for a complex sideways correction in Wave 4. Breakout trading is viable after Wave 4 completes.

essential_price_rules: Wave 5 is the longest wave, being at least 161.8% of Wave 3. Wave 1 and Wave 3 tend to be equal in price and time.
time_rules: Wave 4 must take more time and retrace more of the preceding wave than Wave 2.
trading_action: Wait for Wave 5 to fully extend. A sharp and rapid reversal usually follows an extended 5th wave, offering a high-probability SHORT entry upon completion.

essential_price_rules: Corrections generally consist of three (3) segments (a, b, c). They occur against the trend of one larger degree.
retracement_rule: The first monowave of a Non-Directional period is always retraced more than 61.8%.
trading_action: Do not trade the initial counter-trend move. Wait for at least 3 segments to complete before looking for entries in the direction of the main trend.
